description: List registered device push tokens (masked), PLATFORM-ROUTED (#1542): each `device_push_tokens` row carries a `platform` discriminator — `ios` = an APNs device token (push-notify's APNs leg), `android` = an FCM registration token (push-notify's FCM HTTP v1 leg). The column defaults `ios`, so legacy rows read `ios`. Optionally scope to one device.
name: list_push_tokens
title: List Push Tokens
